name: Bauru
sourceReview: A first-party Prefeitura Municipal de Bauru geoprocessing page links the municipal Geopixel Cidades viewer, and the official SEPLAN digital-maps page identifies a cadastral map and the current platform. The viewer's public configuration exposed a Bauru-specific server, but anonymous service checks did not expose parcel schema or geometry.

queryReview.englishDiscovery: Completed; official municipal geoprocessing and cadastral-map pages found.
queryReview.localLanguageDiscovery: Completed in Brazilian Portuguese; the same first-party municipal GIS/cadastral sources and land-subdivision procedure page were found.

requestOutcomes: Official municipal page and viewer shell/configuration returned 200. Anonymous profile metadata returned 401. Anonymous public-login checks returned 500 for POST and GET. No parcel query was attempted after the service remained inaccessible without authentication; this is not evidence of parcel absence.
safeFieldAllowlist: native parcel identity if later documented
scopeLimits: Municipal custody is evidenced, but no public parcel layer/schema/CRS/native identity was verified.
The official cadastral PDF is not a safe substitute for a bounded native parcel feature response and no polygon was retained.
No owner, titleholder, address, contact, tax/account, legal/title, or personal fields were requested or retained.
No authentication, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was used.
Runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial adapter review.
uncertainty: No claim is made about exact-point parcel presence, citywide coverage, layer availability, legal authority, ownership, tax records, or service completeness. A public map extent miss or login wall would not establish absence.
